resources.string: Apex is a private dashboard for one person. This page explains what it reads, where it goes and how to remove it. It is also the page Health Connect opens when it asks how Apex uses your data.

Your readings, scores and history are stored in a database on this phone, encrypted at rest with SQLCipher. The key is protected by the phone\'s hardware-backed keystore. Android backup is switched off, so the data is not copied to a cloud backup.
Apex contains no analytics or crash-reporting libraries and no advertising. Health values, tokens and keys are never written to logs.

Apex reads from three places: Google Health, Health Connect and a Google Takeout archive you choose. It never writes to any of them and cannot change your data there. Your own entries, such as a check-in or a manual workout, stay in Apex and are marked as yours.
What Apex reads from Health Connect
Each permission below is read-only. You can allow or withdraw each one in Health Connect at any time. Anything you withdraw simply shows as missing.
For the heart-rate chart, zones and Strain.
For Recovery and your resting baseline.
For sleep duration, stages, the sleep score and sleep need.
As a stability check in Recovery and in fatigue signals.
As a stability check in Recovery, shown as a change from your usual.
For your workout list and details.
To show the VO2 max your wearable reports.
For daily activity and workout totals.
So Apex can read further back than 30 days before you first allowed access, to build your baselines sooner. Asked only when Health Connect supports it.
So the periodic sync can read new data while the app is closed. Asked only when Health Connect supports it.
Notifications, only if you turn alerts on. Internet, to reach Google and, if you opt in, Anthropic. A foreground service while a Takeout archive is being imported.
Apex connects to Google to sign you in and to read your Google Health data, with read-only access. It has no other servers.
If you turn on Ask Apex and add your own Anthropic API key, the short summary you see before each question is sent to Anthropic to get an answer. Nothing is sent to Anthropic unless you opt in.
You can export all your data from this phone as a file, or delete it all. Deleting removes the local database and the key that protects it. It does not change anything in Google or Health Connect.
